description: Fill and flatten an existing AcroForm (pdfnative v1.6 via fill_form). Flow: create a fillable form with add_form, discover the field names with read_form_fields, fill the values, then flatten so the result is final and non-editable. Non-destructive incremental update — a prior signature stays valid for its revision. Replace the <base64…> placeholders with the bytes returned by each prior step.
